summary: Fees/services configuration missing for new location
description: Sales Agent received a duplicate merchant ID error message when attempting to add a new location for an existing merchant ID. This prevented the agent from successfully completing the onboarding process.
resolution: Conducted network diagnostics, discovered a bottleneck in the network infrastructure. Implemented QoS settings to prioritize data submission traffic and alleviate timeouts.
